question: Which of the following is a type of plant disease?
solution:
The correct answer is __Blight.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Blight refers to a type of plant disease caused by fungal or bacterial pathogens**.
 
• These pathogens **cause cell death or necrosis, and when large areas of plants have been quickly killed, the disease is described as blight.**
